title: Thermophilization workflow outputs
description: GitHub-hostable metadata for the thermophilization dashboard page. These entries let the app explain expected products even when large local parquet outputs are unavailable.

outputs.label: Condition metadata
outputs.role: Stable plot IDs, condition geography, forest type group, and area fields.

outputs.label: Forested-condition foundation
outputs.role: Which conditions are forest, and each one's share of the visit's forested area. The single source of truth for forest status and area weight.

outputs.label: Disturbance classification
outputs.role: Control/disturbed eligibility, natural disturbance class, timing, and forest type strata.

outputs.label: Species climate niches
outputs.role: The climate found across each species' mapped range. Eight indicators per species.

outputs.label: Condition community climate
outputs.grain: community_layer x PLT_CN x INVYR x CONDID
outputs.role: Weighted mean and median climate affinity per FIA condition. Contains all condition classes, so a forest workflow must filter COND_STATUS_CD == 1.

outputs.label: Forest plot-visit CWM
outputs.role: The analysis response. Forested conditions only, weighted by each one's share of the visit's forested area.

outputs.label: Plot disturbance extent
outputs.role: How much of the plot visit carried fire, insects, disease, weather, treatment, or harvest.

outputs.label: Consecutive-survey change
outputs.grain: community_layer x stable_plot_id x previous_PLT_CN x current_PLT_CN
outputs.role: Change between each survey and the one before it, with annualized rates. Uses FIA's official PREV_PLT_CN remeasurement link only.

outputs.label: First-to-last change
outputs.role: Change from a plot's earliest to latest survey, with all three life stages spanning the same interval.

outputs.label: Before/after survey coverage
outputs.role: Which plots have a survey before and after a disturbance, for each configured query.
